title: Koyaga
text: The Koyaga speak Koyaga (ISO 639-3: kga), an indigenous language classified in the Niger-Congo family, specifically the Mande branch. It is considered a dialect of Jula (Dyula), within the Manding subgroup of Western Mande languages.
